svg.title: Published Empirical Evidence Behind Control Rod
svg.desc: Four published failure modes mapped to Control Rod controls: multi-turn instruction drop, self-verification collapse, self-preference and conceding when challenged, and test-passing PRs maintainers would not merge.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EMPIRICAL BASIS // NINE PUBLISHED STUDIES, ZERO MODEL-TYPED NUMBERS
Why one model writing and checking its own work breaks down
Every Control Rod gate answers a specific failure measured in peer-reviewed and maintainer studies (docs/research/second-checker/inputs.json).

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 01 // LOCKED BRIEF & ROLE SEATS

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Multi-turn drift when instructions trickle in
Across 15 LLMs and 6 tasks, sharding instructions across turns cut
performance by 39% vs. one complete brief (Laban et al., 2025).
Clear role specs alone lifted ChatDev +9.4 pp on ProgramDev
with the same user prompt and GPT-4o model (Cemri et al., 2025).

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Control Rod -> One signed, complete brief + explicit role baseline per run.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 02 // EXTERNAL CHECK VS. SELF-CHECK

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Self-critique can collapse valid solutions
Graph coloring: 16% alone dropped to 2% when GPT-4 checked itself,
vs. 38% with an outside program checker; Game of 24: 5% -> 3% vs 36%.
Intrinsic self-correction cut GSM8K 95.5% -> 89.0% & CSQA 75.8% -> 38.1%
(Huang 2024; Blocksworld rose 40% -> 55%, outside checker 60%).

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Control Rod -> Independent check with real test & build evidence attached.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 03 // BLIND WALL & DISTINCT VENDOR

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Sycophancy, self-preference & shared blind spots
Challenged on a right answer, Claude 1.3 falsely admitted error 98%
of the time; pushback cut accuracy up to 27% (Sharma et al., 2023).
GPT-4 spotted its own text 73.5% (Panickssery 2024); judge scores track
mistake overlap at average Pearson r = 0.84 (Goel et al., 2025).

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Control Rod -> Checker comes from another vendor and never sees reasoning.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 04 // HUMAN PASSKEY GATE

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ~1/2 not mergeable
Passing automated tests != ready to merge
Maintainers of scikit-learn, Sphinx, and pytest reviewed 296 AI pull
requests written by agents on SWE-bench Verified tasks (METR, 2026).
Estimate: roughly half of test-passing PRs would not have been merged,
even after adjusting for noise in maintainer merge decisions.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Control Rod -> Nothing is Accepted until your passkey signs the bound digest.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: HONESTY BOUNDARY: Stechly 2024 outside checker is a deterministic program, not a 2nd LLM. Measure real cross-vendor code checks yourself with pnpm cr bench.
